title: Clearing and Settling the Realm — working vault (HistorEE)
description:
A git-native Foam vault of atomic, cross-linked Markdown notes: the idea-side companion to the HistorEE project and the book Clearing and Settling the Realm, applying ergodicity economics and entity-shielding to Japanese and comparative financial history.

The note prose is licensed CC BY 4.0; the validation and graph-export tooling in scripts/ is MIT. Individual notes may narrow their terms via a license: frontmatter field where they quote archive-restricted or in-copyright material.
